summary.hu: Minden reggel lyukas a papucsuk. Senki sem tudja, miért.
summary.en: Every morning their slippers are full of holes. Nobody knows why.
summary.ro: În fiecare dimineață papucii lor sunt găuriți. Nimeni nu știe de ce.

summary.hu: A király azt mondja: aki kitalálja, feleségül veheti az egyik lányt.
summary.en: The king says: whoever finds out can marry one of the daughters.
summary.ro: Regele spune: cine află poate lua de soție una dintre fete.

summary.hu: Egy ügyes fiú éjjel követi a lányokat.
summary.en: A clever lad follows the girls at night.
summary.ro: Un flăcău isteț le urmărește pe fete noaptea.

summary.hu: A lányok titokban táncolni járnak egy varázslatos helyre.
summary.en: The girls secretly go dancing in a magical place.
summary.ro: Fetele merg pe ascuns la dans într-un loc fermecat.

questions.qEn: What are their slippers like in the morning?

questions.q: Mikor követi a fiú a lányokat?
questions.qEn: When does the lad follow the girls?
What do the girls do in secret?
